result:
All gates pass: codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, and the test suite (14 tests, 12 new). The ADR's links also validate.

**What was built**

- **Schema and migration.** `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` (id, post_id, user_id, body, created_at) and `comment_reports` (id, comment_id, user_id, created_at) with a unique index on the (comment_id, user_id) pair. The generated migration lives under `db/migrations/20260925035626_add_comments/`.
- **Models.** `Comment` (fillable only `body`, relations to author, post, and reports, plus the exported hide threshold of 3) and `CommentReport` (nothing fillable, both keys set server-side).
- **Endpoints.** `CommentController` handles `POST /posts/:id/comments` (validates body 1 to 2000 chars via the route schema, redirects to the post), `DELETE /comments/:id` (policy-checked, redirects to the post), and `POST /comments/:id/report` (always 204, duplicate reports are a no-op, with a unique-constraint catch for races). All three sit behind the existing `auth` alias so guests get the `/login` redirect.
- **Authorization.** `CommentPolicy` allows delete for the comment's author or the post's author, registered next to `PostPolicy` in the authorization provider.
- **Post page.** `PostController.show` now loads comments oldest first with authors, counts report rows per comment, and drops any with three or more. The `posts/Show` page renders the list with author name and timestamp, a comment form for signed-in users, Delete where the viewer may use it, and Report. `PostController.destroy` explicitly removes the post's reports and comments before the post, since SQLite only honours the declared cascades with foreign keys enabled.
- **Tests and docs.** `tests/CommentController.test.ts` covers every contract point in the ticket. ADR 0002 records the moderation rule and links the Comment, CommentReport, and Post entities.

Summary: I added a community-moderated comments feature. The `comments` and `comment_reports` tables were added to `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration; `app/Models/Comment.ts` and `CommentReport.ts` define the models; `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts`, and `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts` implement store, delete, and report with the ownership rules; `routes/web.ts` registers the three auth-guarded routes; `PostController.show` passes a `comments` prop that omits comments reported by three or more distinct users and `destroy` removes dependants; `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` renders the comment list, form, Delete, and Report; `AuthorizationProvider` binds the new policy; `tests/CommentController.test.ts` exercises the whole contract; and `docs/adr/0002-*.md` records the decision. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, and `bunx guren gate` all pass.
